model_output.verdict: A healthcare operations executive whose resume connects growth and operational changes to measurable results.
write_up: This is a strong executive resume! At Lakeshore, you show both the growth of the dental organization and the operating work behind it. Your earlier clinic roles reinforce that story, giving a recruiter a clear reason to move you forward for healthcare operations leadership.

The integration line is a great model: it names the playbook you standardized and shows the change in time. Your progression at Midwest Physician Alliance and your board reporting at Lakeshore also make your leadership level easy to place.

There’s one earlier result we can make more useful by adding how you achieved it. Otherwise, your resume isn’t likely to be the thing standing between you and a callback; the competition for the role and how closely the organization’s needs match your experience will matter too.
